name: Hvac Maintenance
description: Guides homeowners through HVAC system maintenance including filter replacement schedules, seasonal tune-up tasks, efficiency optimization, and troubleshooting common issues. Covers forced air, heat pumps, boilers, mini-splits, and window units with specific intervals and cost ranges. Use when the user asks about furnace or AC maintenance, filter changes, HVAC efficiency, or heating/cooling system care. Do NOT use for full annual home maintenance (use annual-home-maintenance), emergency HVAC failure diagnosis, or commercial HVAC systems.
